english.title: Supervisor of provisional licence holder fail to state date of birth
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person supervising **(..SPECIFY NAME..), the holder of a provisional licence, while

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), having been required by a constable, to produce your

(D)_[licence,]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart,]_

failed in prescribed circumstances, on being required by a constable, to state your date of birth
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, regulation 26 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1987 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1 June 1990 (1 January 1991 in the case of licences granted under laws of Northern Ireland). The "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, was supervising **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, who was driving **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

date of birth to a police constable when requested to do so.
